answer: A willow bends in a gale, and an agent economy should admit new identities by sealed-bid auction for work slots each epoch. Each applicant stakes 40 credits; the top 50 bids win, losers refunded, winners' stakes lock 20 epochs. A forger wanting 100 fakes must outbid honest agents 100 times and lock 4,000 credits, while an honest agent pays once and earns about 120 per epoch. Fake bids push the price up like an echo, so forgery loses money.
